input: Fix the squeaky third stair on the staircase

gold.taskTitle: Fix the squeaky third stair on the staircase
gold.taskDescription: Diagnose and repair the squeak on the third stair of a staircase.

questions.title: Is the staircase made of wood, carpet, or another material?
questions.description: Understanding the stair material helps determine the right repair method and tools.

questions.title: Can you access the underside of the staircase?
questions.description: Access from below opens up different and often easier repair options.

questions.title: How long has the stair been squeaking?
questions.description: Duration can indicate whether this is a minor fix or a sign of deeper structural wear.

questions.title: Do you know what is causing the squeak?
questions.description: Knowing if it is a loose tread, a rubbing riser, or a failing nail narrows down the solution.

questions.title: What tools and materials do you currently have on hand?
questions.description: Knowing available tools helps plan whether a hardware store run is needed.

questions.title: Are you comfortable doing this repair yourself, or considering hiring someone?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan should be a DIY guide or a contractor-finding process.

questions.title: Is the stair in a rented property or one you own?
questions.description: Ownership status affects whether landlord approval or a professional repair report is required.
